description: Jordan’s energy regulator lists licensed conventional electricity-generation companies, plants, technologies and capacities. The page also describes ancillary services and the regulator’s oversight of licensed facilities. The provider is Energy and Minerals Regulatory Commission, Jordan. Coverage: Coverage is Jordan. The page’s national comparison refers to 2021 and 2022 even though the site displays a September 2026 update date; the listed capacities are not verified as current. Access: The official Arabic page was read with the web reader after the local extraction returned navigation text. It lists eight conventional-generation licences. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: The list does not establish a complete renewable-generator inventory. Some reported shares and capacity totals need reconciliation against their original reporting period. For simulation it supplies dated generation-asset and operator information for system inventories. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers this named regulator inventory.
